_doc: Filing-route knowledge keyed on the owner's domicile. Only rows that carry a `source` were read from a primary source (see ultrastable/ops admin/ip/europe/DECISION-MEMO.md, read 2026-11-10); every row has verify_before_use true. Unknown countries get the generic research route, never a route chosen from memory. Working data for attorney review, not legal advice.

defaults.ep_direct_self_filing: Art. 133(1) EPC lets a resident of an EPC contracting state file without a representative

us_rule.text: Final rule 91 FR 13510 (20 Mar 2026), effective 2026-07-20: an applicant whose domicile is outside the US must be represented by a registered practitioner; a provisional still receives a filing date without one, but a foreign-domiciled applicant's ADS is not accepted.
